lesson.title: Conditions, Reasons & Conjunctions
lesson.subtitle: Conditions, "not only… but also", choices, and examples
lesson.description: Connect complex clauses using 不但……而且, 如果……的话, 只要, 只有, 或者, 可是, 根据, and 比如.

learning_objectives: Link ideas with 不但……而且, 可是, 然后, and 直到.
Express conditions with 如果……的话, 只要, and 只有.
Give alternatives and examples with 或, 或者, 根据, and 比如.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Core clause connectors and conditional markers that build multi-clause Mandarin.
overview.focus: Contrast 只要……就 ("as long as") with 只有……才 ("only if"), and use 或者 (not 还是) for "or" in statements.

examples.pinyin: bǐrú shénme?
examples.english: For example, what?
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 比如.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢水果，比如苹果和香蕉。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ, bǐrú píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
examples.english: I like fruit, such as apples and bananas.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 比如.

examples.hanzi: 他不但会唱歌，还会跳舞。
examples.pinyin: tā búdàn huì chàng gē, hái huì tiàowǔ.
examples.english: He can not only sing but also dance.
examples.teaching_note: 不但 normally combines with 还 or 而且 to express not only…but also.

examples.hanzi: 这个地方不但安静，而且很干净。
examples.pinyin: zhège dìfang búdàn ānjìng, érqiě hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: This place is not only quiet but also very clean.
examples.teaching_note: Written descriptive contrast: 不但…而且… links two positive properties, alongside the conversational 不但…还… example.

examples.pinyin: lèi dehuà, jiù xiūxi ba.
examples.english: If you're tired, take a break.
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 的话.

examples.pinyin: xià yǔ dehuà, wǒmen jiù zài jiā.
examples.english: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 的话.

examples.pinyin: tā huì chàng gē, érqiě huì tiàowǔ.

examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 而且.

examples.hanzi: 这家饭店便宜，而且很好吃。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā fàndiàn piányi, érqiě hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant is inexpensive, and the food is delicious.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 而且.

examples.pinyin: gēnjù dìtú, wǒmen wǎng dōng zǒu.
examples.english: According to the map, we go east.
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 根据.

examples.hanzi: 根据老师的要求，学生每天要复习课文。
examples.pinyin: gēnjù lǎoshī de yāoqiú, xuéshēng měitiān yào fùxí kèwén.

examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 根据.

examples.pinyin: zuò chē huò zǒulù dōu kěyǐ.

examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 或.

examples.hanzi: 学生可以用笔或电脑写作业。
examples.pinyin: xuéshēng kěyǐ yòng bǐ huò diànnǎo xiě zuòyè.

examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 或.

examples.pinyin: yào chá huòzhě kāfēi?

examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 或者.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们可以看电影或者去公园。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen kěyǐ kàn diànyǐng huòzhě qù gōngyuán.
examples.english: On weekends, we can watch a movie or go to the park.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 或者.

examples.pinyin: zhèyàng kě bùxíng.
examples.english: This really won't do.
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 可.

examples.pinyin: “zhè jiàn shì kě bù néng wàng.” lǎoshī shuō.

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù, kěshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.english: I want to go, but I don't have time.

examples.pinyin: tā hěn lèi, kěshì hái zài gōngzuò.
examples.english: He is tired, but he is still working.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 可是.

examples.pinyin: xiān chī fàn, ránhòu zǒu.
examples.english: Let's eat first, then go.
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 然后.

examples.hanzi: 他做完作业，然后去睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā zuò wán zuòyè, ránhòu qù shuìjiào.
examples.english: He finished his homework, then went to bed.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 然后.

examples.pinyin: rúguǒ xià yǔ ne?

examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 如果.

examples.hanzi: 如果明天天气好，我们就去公园。

examples.english: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go to the park.

examples.pinyin: zhídào jīntiān wǒ cái zhīdào.
examples.english: I only found out today.
examples.teaching_note: 直到 introduces the time or point at which a situation continues.

examples.hanzi: 他一直在医院，直到昨天才回家。
examples.pinyin: tā yìzhí zài yīyuàn, zhídào zuótiān cái huí jiā.
examples.english: He stayed at the hospital and did not return home until yesterday.
examples.teaching_note: 直到 introduces the time or point at which a situation continues.

examples.pinyin: zhǐyào nǐ lái jiù hǎo!

examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 只要.

examples.hanzi: 只要每天练习，就能学好汉语。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào měi tiān liànxí, jiù néng xué hǎo Hànyǔ.
examples.english: As long as you practice daily, you can learn Chinese well.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 只要.

items.meaning_en: only; only if; there is only

examples.pinyin: wǒ zhǐyǒu shí kuài qián.
examples.english: I only have ten yuan.
examples.teaching_note: Short everyday spoken use of 只有.

examples.pinyin: zhèlǐ zhǐyǒu yì jiā shāngdiàn.
examples.english: There is only one shop here.
examples.teaching_note: Simple descriptive or narrative use of 只有.

examples.pinyin: tā hái zài xuéxiào.
examples.english: He is still at school.
examples.teaching_note: 还 means “still,” showing that the school situation continues.

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn hái méiyǒu kāimén.
examples.english: This shop hasn't opened yet.
examples.teaching_note: Short beginner-level description illustrating 还 in context.

examples.pinyin: wǒ yě xǐhuan chá.
examples.english: I also like tea.
examples.teaching_note: 也 means also; it normally appears before the verb or adjective predicate.

examples.hanzi: 学生也可以在这里看书。
examples.pinyin: xuéshēng yě kěyǐ zài zhèlǐ kàn shū.
examples.english: Students can also read books here.
examples.teaching_note: School or study context showing 也 in a simple description.

examples.pinyin: wǒ zhèngzài kàn shū.
examples.english: I am reading a book right now.
examples.teaching_note: 正在 makes the ongoing action explicit: reading right now.

examples.pinyin: xuéshēngmen zhèngzài shàngkè.
examples.english: The students are having class right now.
examples.teaching_note: School or study context showing 正在 in a simple description.

grammar_points.title: Using 比如 (bǐrú)
grammar_points.explanation: 比如 (bǐrú) means “for example; such as” (verb).

questions.prompt: According to many teachers’ experience in the reading, what is the best teacher?
questions.explanation: The passage states 根据很多老师的经验，兴趣是最好的老师.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences: one using 不但……而且 and one using 如果……的话 or 只要……就.
questions.answer: 这门课不但有用，而且老师讲得很清楚。只要认真复习，考试就一定能通过。
questions.explanation: Use 不但……而且 and 只要……就.

questions.prompt: Which conjunction pair means "only if…, only then…"?
questions.explanation: 只有……才 expresses a necessary condition.

questions.prompt: Which word means "for example / such as"?
Which word means "or" in a statement?
questions.explanation: 或者 is used for "or" in statements.

dialogue.title: Deciding on a Weekend Plan
dialogue.context_en: Two friends weigh conditions and alternatives for a Saturday outing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 如果明天不下雨的话，咱们去爬山吧，可是要是下雨怎么办？
turns.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān bú xià yǔ dehuà, zánmen qù páshān ba, kěshì yàoshi xià yǔ zěnme bàn?
turns.english: If it doesn’t rain tomorrow, let’s go hiking—but what if it rains?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 根据天气预报，明天是晴天。而且即使下雨，咱们也可以去博物馆或者看电影。
turns.pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān shì qíngtiān. Érqiě jíshǐ xià yǔ, zánmen yě kěyǐ qù bówùguǎn huòzhě kàn diànyǐng.
turns.english: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow is sunny. And even if it rains, we can go to a museum or watch a movie.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 山顶风景不但很美，而且空气也特别新鲜！
turns.pinyin: Shāndǐng fēngjǐng búdàn hěn měi, érqiě kōngqì yě tèbié xīnxiān!
turns.english: The scenery at the mountaintop is not only beautiful, but the air is also especially fresh!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 对呀，只要明天早点儿出门，咱们就能在山顶多待一会儿，直到下午再下山。
turns.pinyin: Duì ya, zhǐyào míngtiān zǎodiǎnr chūmén, zánmen jiù néng zài shāndǐng duō dāi yíhuìr, zhídào xiàwǔ zài xiàshān.
turns.english: Right—as long as we leave early tomorrow, we can stay longer at the top and not come down until afternoon.

patterns.title: Not only… but also with 不但……而且
patterns.explanation_en: Use 不但……而且 (búdàn… érqiě) to add a stronger or second positive/negative point.
patterns.pattern_pseudo_translation: <Subject> + not only + <Clause A> + , but also + <Clause B>

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅不但菜好吃，而且服务也很热情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng búdàn cài hǎochī, érqiě fúwù yě hěn rèqíng.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has delicious food, but the service is also warm.

examples.hanzi: 他不但会说英语，而且汉语也说得很流利。
examples.pinyin: Tā búdàn huì shuō Yīngyǔ, érqiě Hànyǔ yě shuō de hěn liúlì.
examples.english: He can not only speak English, but also speaks Chinese very fluently.

patterns.title: 只要……就 vs. 只有……才
patterns.explanation_en: 只要……就 ("as long as…, then…") gives a sufficient condition; 只有……才 ("only if…, only then…") gives a necessary condition.
patterns.pattern_pseudo_translation: as long as + <Condition> + , then + <Result>  /  only if + <Condition> + , only then + <Result>

examples.hanzi: 只要每天练习，你的发音就会越来越好。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào měitiān liànxí, nǐ de fāyīn jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo.
examples.english: As long as you practice every day, your pronunciation will get better and better.

examples.hanzi: 只有认真复习，才能考出好成绩。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu rènzhēn fùxí, cái néng kǎochū hǎo chéngjì.
examples.english: Only if you review seriously can you get good exam grades.

guided_building.instruction_en: Connect clauses with conditions, examples, and time limits.

model.hanzi: 如果你有空的话，咱们先吃饭，然后再去看电影。
model.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒukòng dehuà, zánmen xiān chīfàn, ránhòu zài qù kàn diànyǐng.
model.english: If you have time, let’s eat first and then go see a movie.

substitutions.cue_en: Give two examples of healthy fruit using 比如.

model_answer.hanzi: 我喜欢吃很多水果，比如西瓜和香蕉。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī hěn duō shuǐguǒ, bǐrú xīguā hé xiāngjiāo.
model_answer.english: I like eating many fruits, such as watermelon and bananas.

substitutions.cue_en: Say he kept working until 9 p.m.

model_answer.hanzi: 他一直工作到晚上九点，直到做完才回家。
model_answer.pinyin: Tā yìzhí gōngzuò dào wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn, zhídào zuò wán cái huí jiā.
model_answer.english: He kept working until 9 p.m. and didn’t go home until he finished.

substitutions.cue_en: Say you can choose tea or juice.

model_answer.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ hē chá huò hē guǒzhī.
model_answer.english: You can drink tea or drink juice.

paragraphs.hanzi: 学习外语的方法有很多，比如看电影、听音乐或者读故事。根据很多老师的经验，兴趣是最好的老师。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ de fāngfǎ yǒu hěn duō, bǐrú kàn diànyǐng, tīng yīnyuè huòzhě dú gùshi. Gēnjù hěn duō lǎoshī de jīngyàn, xìngqù shì zuì hǎo de lǎoshī.
paragraphs.english: There are many methods for learning a foreign language, such as watching movies, listening to music, or reading stories. According to many teachers’ experience, interest is the best teacher.

paragraphs.hanzi: 如果只背课本的话，学习可能有点儿枯燥；可是只要把学习跟自己的爱好结合起来，学起来就会轻松得多。
paragraphs.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ bèi kèběn dehuà, xuéxí kěnéng yǒudiǎnr kūzào; kěshì zhǐyào bǎ xuéxí gēn zìjǐ de àihào jiéhé qǐlái, xué qǐlái jiù huì qīngsōng de duō.
paragraphs.english: If you only memorize the textbook, studying can be a bit dry; however, as long as you combine study with your own hobbies, learning becomes much easier.

questions.prompt_en: What examples of language-learning methods are given?
questions.answer_en: Watching movies, listening to music, or reading stories.

questions.prompt_en: What makes studying much easier according to the passage?
questions.answer_en: Combining study with your own hobbies.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe a city, restaurant, or friend using 不但……而且.

model_answer.hanzi: 我的朋友不但聪明，而且非常愿意帮助别人。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou búdàn cōngmíng, érqiě fēicháng yuànyì bāngzhù biérén.
model_answer.english: My friend is not only clever, but also very willing to help others.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: State a condition for success using 只要……就 or 只有……才.

model_answer.hanzi: 只有每天坚持练习，才能把口语说流利。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu měitiān jiānchí liànxí, cái néng bǎ kǒuyǔ shuō liúlì.
model_answer.english: Only if you keep practicing every day can you speak fluently.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: Use 或者 (or 或) for "or" in statements ("tea or coffee"), and 还是 for "or" in questions ("tea or coffee?").
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 不但 (búdàn) changes 不 to rising bú before fourth-tone dàn; 而且 (érqiě) pairs rising ér with third-tone qiě.

can_do: Connect clauses with 不但……而且, 可是, and 然后.
Express conditions with 如果……的话, 只要, and 只有.
Use 或者, 比如, 根据, and 直到.
